source.title: חוק הפיקוח על שירותים פיננסיים (קופות גמל), התשס"ה-2005, ss.1, 13, 39 (Wikisource mirror)

regulator.notes: A new comprehensive pension fund (קרן חדשה מקיפה) is a provident fund for annuity (s.1); managing companies are under the Commissioner's supervision (s.39(א)). The CMA also selects the default ("selected") funds (PEN-06, PEN-23).

source.title: Provident Funds (Management Fees) Regulations 2012, reg. 3(א) (Hebrew Wikisource; Nevo mirror): "מתוך התשלומים המועברים לקרן בשל כל עמית – בשיעור שלא יעלה על 6%"

deposit.notes: Maximum fee on payments transferred to a new comprehensive pension fund. Selected funds charge 1% for new members, fixed for at least 10 years (PEN-23); the 2024 average charged was 1.57% (PEN-24).

source.title: Provident Funds (Management Fees) Regulations 2012, reg. 3(א) (Hebrew Wikisource; Nevo mirror)

balance.notes: Maximum fee per year of each member's balance in a new comprehensive pension fund; 0.3% for old-age pensioners whose pension started on or after 1 February 2022. Selected funds charge 0.22% for new members (PEN-23); the 2024 average charged was 0.15% (PEN-24).

source.title: Harel, "תקרות וסכומים לשנת 2026" (March 2026), p. 1: comprehensive-fund monthly deposit ceiling, 20.5% of twice the average wage; Mor general fund bylaws 01.04.2026, s.1 (NIS 5,645)

amount.notes: NIS per month, 2026. Monthly deposits above the lower of this ceiling and 22.83% of the reported salary components are moved automatically to the same manager's general pension fund (PEN-10). Institution sources only: the Income Tax regulation defining the ceiling was not opened (PEN OQ6); the NII's own 2026 average wage was not reached (PEN OQ5). Updated with the average wage every year.

labels: blocked: annuity conversion factors not collected (PEN OQ7); the page shows the gross balance and the exemption rule (G-03)
blocked: early withdrawal's taxable base open (TXP OQ3; G-06)
the exempt share of the qualifying-annuity ceiling steps up by law in 2027 and 2028 (TXP-14)

source.title: Retirement Age Law 2004, s.5 (early retirement age, 60 for men and women) (Wikisource mirror); Mor comprehensive pension fund bylaws 01.06.2025, s.1 "גיל זכאות מינימלי לקצבת זקנה" and s.41

age.notes: Minimum old-age eligibility age in the pension fund: the early retirement age, 60 for men and women. The pension is the balance divided by the conversion factor in force (PEN-27); the tax exemption starts at retirement age, 67 for men and 65 for women (TXP-14, PEN-26).

source.title: Mor comprehensive pension fund bylaws, version 01.06.2025, s.108 and annex א

payout_business_days.notes: An approved lump-sum withdrawal (severance component, small balances) is paid within 4 business days; the first pension payment is by the third of the month after eligibility. Bylaws-level (Mor).

lawful_exit.text: the lawful exit is an old-age pension from the minimum eligibility age, 60 (early retirement age); before that only the severance component on leaving a job and the narrow cases in the law (small balances past mandatory retirement age, pre-2000 money, health and income conditions) can be taken as a lump sum; any other withdrawal is a non-compliant withdrawal taxed at the higher of 35% and the marginal rate, whose taxable base is open (TXP OQ3), so early withdrawal is a blocked route (method F-48, G-06); the annuity itself needs conversion factors that are not collected (PEN OQ7), so the exit value is blocked too (F-49, G-03) and the page shows the gross balance with the exemption rule as text

source.title: Income Tax Regulations (Rules for Approval and Management of Provident Funds) 1964, reg. 33ב (Wikisource mirror); Mor comprehensive bylaws 01.06.2025, ss.19-22; Income Tax Ordinance s.9(2) (fund income exempt)

switch_is_tax_event.notes: A move between investment tracks inside the fund is completed within 3 business days and is not a withdrawal; the fund's income is exempt and the member is taxed only at exit (TXP-13). Whether a transfer between pension funds is tax-neutral is not stated in the tax rule base (SW OQ8), so the checklist row is blocked on that question.

transfer_routes.condition: insurance continuity and qualifying period rules apply at the receiving fund
deposits above the comprehensive monthly ceiling move automatically; a member transfer between annuity funds is also allowed
between annuity funds; the pooled insurance cover does not move

eligibility.text: every employee from age 21 (men) or 20 (women) must be insured by the employer after a 6-month waiting period, at least 6% employee, 6.5% employer and 6% severance of the wage up to the average wage; an employee who does not choose is placed in one of the four selected funds; the self-employed must deposit into a provident fund for annuity; monthly deposits above the comprehensive ceiling go to the general fund

protection.text: assets are held in trust, separately from the managing company's property, and cannot be attached; if the company fails, management moves to another company; the state does not guarantee the fund's value; 30% of the assets are in a state guaranteed-return track with a 5.15% a year target checked every 60 months; members' balances are also adjusted every year by the fund's actuarial surplus or deficit from demographic factors
